verdict.rationale: Lago's docs describe a built-in AI agent that manages billing from plain-language requests (lago-docs-28). They also describe a first-party Dunning Agent that reads a customer's invoice and payment history, chases overdue invoices and hands the rest to a person (lago-docs-10, lago-docs-25). Together these show users can delegate billing and collections tasks to an in-product assistant. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the general agent's scope and supported actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the in-product assistant works as claimed.
